sentences.en: How many hamburgers do you think you ate last year?
sentences.zh: 去年你觉得你吃了多少个汉堡包？

sentences.en: Can I have two hamburgers and a coke, please?
sentences.zh: 请给我来两个汉堡包和一杯可乐。

sentences.en: I don't like such things as steaks and hamburgers.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢牛排和汉堡包这类的东西。

senses.zh: 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
